audio_output: Always zero DMA output; A2 output remains private.

timing.DWT: A2 processing only; read-only counter; concurrent resets not exhaustively detected.
timing.GPT1: Existing stock start 0x11663 and stop/read 0x11671 services; same clock configuration, IRQ state and prescaler as stock.
timing.body_scope: Starts before housekeeping and clearing outputs; ends after A2, DWT accounting and output validation. Excludes initial validation/prologue, final timer-result accounting, interrupt entry/exit and release latency.
timing.missed_release_observation: Repeated DMA half stops test. Alternation cannot detect an even number of missed releases; no complete underrun proof.

phases.4: timer, DWT, buffer or half-sequence fault

live_pages_32_to_47: Same core, clock, MPU and watchdog register order as NAMA2B01.
reader: tools/mpp_a2_input_client.c; refuses custom queries without exact NAMA2I01 identity.
completion_rule: Phase 2, exactly 180000 batches, zero fault fields, enabled stable DWT, valid sums and stable result words 7..31 plus 56..61 across two reads. Compare quiet and strummed trials to establish input response.
recovery: NAMPB001 was recovered with exact stock after a failed application boot. NAMPB002 and NAMA2B01 returned to blue mode. NAMA2C01 completed two continuous trials across a normal restart; its blue-mode return remains to be checked. These specific observations do not guarantee this new build or arbitrary-damage recovery.
input: Raw signed Q31 slot 3 normalized by 2^-31. Four per-slot peak meters; no stock input conditioning or effects.

input_meter_pages.60: slot 3 samples with magnitude >= 0x7f000000; near-full-scale, not proof of analog clipping

guitar_trial_plan: After installation, boot normally with guitar connected, volume at zero and headphones unplugged; wait 45 seconds. Read two frozen snapshots.
Restart normally with guitar volume up and strum from about 10 to 40 seconds after startup. Read two frozen snapshots. Compare channel peaks, model response and fault/timing counters.
